summary: Architecture's producer manual, seed skill, USAGE.md, README and architecture-update doc point producers at arch-validate in the aac-tools toolchain instead of a copied script. The update-architecture agent reads a generated producer's contract from cexec aac-tools gen-architecture --help when its sources lack the generator, and .kubecoder/config.yaml declares aac-tools (ae5107f on phase/026-P8). kc project setup and kc project test are green.
